notes.title: Release Date Postponed
notes.notes:
Frontier Works Inc. has revised the release date of their upcoming title, Heroic Songs: the Remix!, to focus on improving the quality of the release. 



Updated Release Date: Wednesday, October 8, 2025



We understand this is disappointing news for players eager for the release, but we appreciate your patience and understanding as we focus on releasing a polished product. In the meantime, we will continue to provide updates on the game’s content.
